item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q016_pdb_1acc_domain_split","answer":"In SCOP 1.75, PDB 1acc chain A was treated as one SCOP domain, d1acca_, covering 1acc A: as family/superfamily/fold f.11.1.1/f.11.1/f.11, “Anthrax protective antigen,” in class f, “Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides.” In SCOPe 2.08 the same chain is split into two independent classified domains: d1acca2, 1acc A:14-225, is the N-terminal PA14 domain in family b.179.1.1 “PA14,” superfamily b.179.1 “PA14-like,” fold b.179 “Anthrax protective antigen N-terminal-like,” class b “All beta proteins”; d1acca1, 1acc A:226-735, is the C-terminal anthrax-protective-antigen-like domain in family/superfamily/fold f.60.1.1/f.60.1/f.60, all named “Anthrax protective antigen C-terminal-like,” in class f. These two SCOPe 2.08 domains share no classified ancestor below the SCOP root: the 1.75 all-chain unit was therefore a historical composite definition that SCOPe later decomposed into at least two different evolutionary modules, not evidence that the PA14-like N-terminal beta module and the C-terminal f.60 module are mutually homologous. Homology searches or representative selection should consequently be domain-bounded: use residues 14-225 as a PA14-like query/template and residues 226-735 as an f.60 C-terminal-like query/template. A match to one segment of 1accA should not transfer the other segment’s family, superfamily, fold, membrane/cell-surface class, toxin annotation, boundaries, or domain count, and the obsolete SCOP 1.75 full-chain family f.11.1.1 should not be used as a single representative for modern SCOPe searches.","evidence_used":["get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","resolve_scop_identifier: /api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/1acc","get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/domains","get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/domains","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/parents; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology","compare_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology"]}]}
